Test Case Description: Verify Edit Card Status screen loads successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in and has access to Edit Card Status
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Start > Accounts Maintenance > Edit Card Status
2. Wait for the screen to finish loading
3. Observe Stage Selection, Card Status List, Behind The Scene, status bar, and action panel
Expected Result: The screen loads without script errors. Stage dropdown, card grid, audit fields, and action buttons are visible. Status bar shows Ready.
Remarks: Derived from EditCardStatus Index.cshtml and edit-card-status.js.

Test Case Description: Verify legacy Edit Card Status route opens the migrated screen
Preconditions: User is logged in
Test Steps:
1. Open /MoneaSys/EditCardStatus?ModuleID=<valid module id>
2. Observe the rendered page
Expected Result: The legacy route resolves to the current Edit Card Status screen and the screen remains usable.

Test Case Description: Verify stage dropdown is populated from server-provided options
Preconditions: Edit Card Status screen is open
Test Steps: 1. Open the Stage dropdown
Expected Result: Available stage options are shown from the ViewData stage list and the default option remains -- Select Stage --.

Test Case Description: Verify initial empty-state and audit state before View
Preconditions: Edit Card Status screen is open
Test Steps:
1. Observe the grid before selecting any stage
2. Observe the Behind The Scene fields
Expected Result: The grid shows the initial no-details prompt. Audit fields display -. No row is selected.

Test Case Description: Verify View with no stage selected shows validation prompt
Preconditions: No stage is selected
Test Steps: 1. Click View
Expected Result: The screen warns the user to select stage and click View to load. No records are requested for display.

Test Case Description: Verify changing stage resets the current loaded grid state
Preconditions: Records are already loaded for one stage
Test Steps: 1. Change the Stage dropdown to a different stage
Expected Result: Current selection is cleared and the grid returns to the no-details prompt until View is clicked for the new stage.

Test Case Description: Verify View loads cards for the selected stage
Preconditions: A valid stage with available card records exists
Test Steps:
1. Select a valid stage
2. Click View
Expected Result: Cards load into the grid, record count updates, KPI totals update, and the first row becomes selected automatically.

Test Case Description: Verify response code 1011 is shown as no-details state
Preconditions: Selected stage has no records or backend returns response code 1011
Test Steps:
1. Select a stage with no records
2. Click View
Expected Result: The grid shows No details Found [No:1011]. Status bar reflects the same state. No stale records remain in the grid.

Test Case Description: Verify row click changes current selected card
Preconditions: Card records are loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click a different row in the card grid
Expected Result: The clicked row becomes the current selection and the selection highlight moves to that row only.

Test Case Description: Verify row selection updates Behind The Scene audit fields
Preconditions: Card records are loaded
Test Steps:
1. Click any loaded row
2. Observe Created By, Created On, Approved By, Approved On, Exported By, Exported On, Activated By, Activated On, Disbursed By, and Disbursed On
Expected Result: Behind The Scene values refresh to the selected card record's audit information.

Test Case Description: Verify Select All behaves as single-selection helper
Preconditions: Card records are loaded
Test Steps:
1. Check Select All
2. Observe the current selection
3. Uncheck Select All
Expected Result: Checking Select All results in a selected row state for the current record set. Unchecking clears the selected row and resets audit fields.
Remarks: This screen supports single-row workflow selection rather than bulk approval.

Test Case Description: Verify View after records are already loaded refreshes Behind The Scene for the selected row
Preconditions: Card records are loaded and one row is selected
Test Steps:
1. Select a row
2. Click View again without changing stage
Expected Result: The selected row remains the focus for audit display and the status bar indicates the viewed card.

Test Case Description: Verify Edit action shows informational guidance instead of editing
Preconditions: A row is selected
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit
Expected Result: The screen informs the user that edit mode is not defined for this workflow and instructs the user to use Approve for the selected card.

Test Case Description: Verify Approve is blocked when no row is selected
Preconditions: Records are loaded but no row is selected
Test Steps:
1. Clear the current selection
2. Click Approve
Expected Result: The user is warned to select a card first and no approval request is sent.

Test Case Description: Verify approval is blocked for invalid TrackingCardID
Preconditions: A selected row has missing, zero, or invalid TrackingCardID
Test Steps:
1. Select a row with invalid TrackingCardID
2. Click Approve
Expected Result: Approval is blocked and the user is warned that the selected card has invalid TrackingCardID.
Remarks: Use controlled test data or a mocked response if needed.

Test Case Description: Verify approval confirmation can be cancelled
Preconditions: A valid row is selected
Test Steps:
1. Click Approve
2. Choose Cancel in the confirmation dialog
Expected Result: No approval request is sent and the status bar indicates the approval was cancelled.

Test Case Description: Verify successful approval of selected card status
Preconditions: A valid row is selected and backend service is available
Test Steps:
1. Select a valid card row
2. Click Approve
3. Confirm the action in the confirmation dialog
Expected Result: Approval succeeds. A success message is displayed and the grid reloads for the current stage.

Test Case Description: Verify approval payload carries required legacy update fields
Preconditions: A valid row is selected and backend request tracing is available
Test Steps:
1. Approve a selected record
2. Inspect the request or audit output
Expected Result: The approval request includes TrackingCardID, BranchID, AccountID, ModifiedBy, ModifiedOn, ApprovedBy, ApprovalDate, IsApproved, CardStatus set to APPROVED, and UpdateCount.
Remarks: Derived from buildApprovedCardPayload in the JavaScript.

Test Case Description: Verify cancel action clears the selected row only
Preconditions: Card records are loaded and a row is selected
Test Steps: 1. Click Cancel
Expected Result: The selected row is cleared. Loaded records remain in the grid. Behind The Scene fields reset to -.

Test Case Description: Verify refresh action reloads records for the current stage
Preconditions: A stage is selected
Test Steps: 1. Click the header Refresh action
Expected Result: The screen reloads card status for the current stage and remains responsive.

Test Case Description: Verify close action exits the screen cleanly in the host container
Preconditions: Edit Card Status screen is open in its supported host
Test Steps: 1. Click Close
Expected Result: The screen closes cleanly using the appropriate host close behavior without JavaScript errors.

Test Case Description: Verify expired or missing authentication blocks direct access
Preconditions: User session is expired or unauthenticated
Test Steps: 1. Open the Edit Card Status route directly without a valid session
Expected Result: The user is redirected to login or blocked from viewing protected data.

Test Case Description: Verify stagewise card retrieval failure is handled gracefully
Preconditions: Backend dependency is unavailable or times out
Test Steps:
1. Select a stage
2. Click View while the dependency is unavailable
Expected Result: The grid shows a graceful failure state, status bar indicates an error searching cards, and the user sees an error message.

Test Case Description: Verify approval failure is handled gracefully
Preconditions: A valid row is selected but the approval dependency is unavailable or returns failure
Test Steps:
1. Click Approve
2. Confirm the action while the dependency is unavailable or returns an error
Expected Result: The approval fails gracefully, an error message is shown, and the grid remains usable.

Test Case Description: Verify KPI counters match the loaded records
Preconditions: Loaded records contain a mix of approved, active, and collected values
Test Steps:
1. Load card records for a stage
2. Count approved, active, and collected values in the grid
3. Compare counts with KPI badges
Expected Result: Total, Approved, Active, and Collected KPI values match the loaded records.

Test Case Description: Verify message panel can be dismissed manually
Preconditions: A success, warning, or error message is visible
Test Steps:
1. Trigger any visible message
2. Click the message panel close button
Expected Result: The message panel closes immediately without affecting the current grid state.

Test Case Description: Verify responsive layout keeps grid
Priority: and action buttons usable on smaller screens
Preconditions: UI
Test Steps: P3
Expected Result: Edit Card Status screen is available on desktop and smaller viewport widths
Actual Result:
1. Open the screen on desktop width
2. Reduce the viewport to tablet width
3. Verify grid, audit section, and action buttons
Status: The layout remains usable, the message panel repositions correctly, and core actions remain accessible.
